summary.zh: 决定代码怎么分层、何时该抽出新抽象
summary.en: Decide how to layer code and when to add abstractions

description.zh: 围绕单一职责、关注点分离和组合优于继承，判断类与模块之间的边界。适合从零设计服务、拆分过大的类，或在评审中识别耦合过紧的结构。
description.en: Guides module boundaries around single responsibility, separation of concerns, and composition over inheritance. Use it when designing a service, splitting an oversized class, or reviewing tight coupling.
